notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710848/11d3a8da8166927014393ef1812c62b1dc7c217d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To all players,[/p][p][/p][p]We regret to inform you that we have made the difficult decision to end operations for Vixen Wars.[/p][p]The game will no longer be supported starting December 2nd, 2025. [/p][p]Please note that as of today, September 2nd you should no longer make any in-game purchases, and the servers will be shut down on the 2nd of December.[/p][p][/p][p]Our sincere thanks go out to all of you for your continued support and understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing,[/p][p]The Vixen Wars team.[/p]

notes.title: Valentine’s Dos and Don’ts
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine’s Day!

♫Love is in the air♫ and our ladies are ready to be pampered & romanced!
The past year has been rough all around, and we still have to stay home in order to stay safe, but that only means you can get even more creative about what date to take your favorite lady on!

Getting creative with your dates is vital ❤ But if you go overboard, your lady won’t be very pleased!

But don’t worry, we’re here to help~!
Here are some ideas on how not to mess things up this Valentine’s!

All girls dream about a romantic getaway, but instead of going on a trip, how about you spend time at home, hanging out and playing Vixen Wars together?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254530/Vixen_Wars/

It’s not always about expensive things! Win her over with a home-cooked meal and she’s sure to appreciate it more!

Got any other Valentine’s dos and don’ts? Share them with us!

Love, 
The Vixen Wars team
